Maya Linden
Marketing graduate
maya.linden@example.com | +1 555 0142 | Portland, OR, USA
linkedin.com/in/maya-linden-example

PROFILE
Recent communications graduate with one marketing internship and two years running the social channels of a student society. I like turning a rough idea into a post people actually share, and I am looking for my first full-time marketing role.

EDUCATION
B.A. Communications, minor in Psychology | Westbrook University | Sep 2021 - Jun 2025
- Final grade: 3.6 GPA
- Thesis: how short-form video changes brand recall among 18 to 24 year olds (survey of 212 students)

EXPERIENCE
Marketing Intern | Harbor Street Pet Supply (local retailer, 14 staff) | Jun 2025 - Sep 2025
- Wrote and scheduled 3 Instagram posts and 1 newsletter per week
- Grew the newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers over the summer by adding a sign-up QR code at the till
- Helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought in about 300 visitors

Social Media Lead | Westbrook Film Society (student society) | Sep 2022 - Jun 2025
- Ran the society's Instagram and TikTok accounts and trained two new volunteers
- Raised average ticket sales for screenings from 35 to 60 per event through a weekly "pick of the week" reel

Barista | Corner Bean Cafe | Jun 2021 - Aug 2024 (part-time and summers)
- Served up to 150 customers per shift and trained 4 new colleagues

SKILLS
Content: copywriting, Canva, CapCut, basic Adobe Photoshop
Channels: Instagram, TikTok, Mailchimp, Hootsuite
Analytics: Google Analytics (basic), Instagram Insights, Excel
Languages: English (native), Spanish (conversational)

CERTIFICATIONS
Google Analytics for Beginners (2024)
HubSpot Content Marketing course (2024)
